comment: Pinned browser stack for the UI-002 contained browser gate. Every entry is
immutable and content-addressed: Chrome for Testing publishes versioned,
never-rewritten archive paths, and the base image is referenced by manifest
digest rather than by tag. scripts/ui-browser/build-image.sh refuses to build
when any recorded digest does not match what was fetched.
Recorded 2026-09-10 from the Chrome for Testing Stable channel.
debian_snapshot is the archive timestamp the base image itself records in
that snapshot so the package closure is as immutable as the base digest.
